summary.text: Steve Tharinger represents the 24th Legislative District, which includes all of Clallam and Jefferson counties and part of Grays Harbor County, in the Washington House of Representatives. His official biography says he was first elected in 2010 and chairs the House Capital Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: Tharinger is a former small business owner and three-term Clallam County Commissioner, according to his official biography, and received a Bachelor of Arts from Colorado College.
The page says he is a state-certified volunteer mediator with the Peninsula Dispute Resolution Center and a member of the Sequim Sunrise Rotary.
As chair of the Capital Budget Committee he helps write the state's capital investment budget, and he also serves on the Health Care and Wellness and Appropriations committees, the page says.

It adds that he served on the Salmon Recovery Funding Board from 2002 to 2008, co-chairs the Joint Legislative Executive Committee on Aging and Disability, and is a member of the Dementia Action Collaborative.
